content.ascii:
MappingPage                              baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
MappingPocPage -> MappingServicesContext -> MappingWorkspacePage
|-- supplied services
|   |-- diagrams: DiagramService                sole diagram content writer
|   |-- canvasHistory: CanvasHistoryService     owns history behind handles
|   `-- workspaceStorage?: WorkspaceStorage     otherwise created by page
|
|-- workspace: CanvasWorkspace                  owns session lifetimes
|   |-- drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
|   |   |-- metadata                            name / representationId / revisionId
|   |   |-- saved baseline                      savedName / savedScene / savedEdges
|   |   |-- busy / hidden / viewport / focusBox
|   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
|   |       |-- controller: MappingDocumentController
|   |       |   |-- diagrams / historyService    supplied service references
|   |       |   |-- context: CanvasEditingContext
|   |       |   |   `-- contextId                opaque handle from openContext()
|   |       |   |-- getSnapshot(): ControllerSnapshot
|   |       |   |   |-- contextId / canvasRevisionId / version
|   |       |   |   |-- canUndo / canRedo / cell / endpointBounds
|   |       |   |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument
|   |       |   |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene
|   |       |   |   |   |   |-- root: GridBox     recursive instance/layout tree
|   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- shared        id / position / collapsed
|   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- diagram       contentId -> contents
|   |       |   |   |   |   |   `-- container     children[] / push-right / gap
|   |       |   |   |   |   `-- contents[contentId]: Diagram
|   |       |   |   |   |       |-- diagramId / revisionId / id / revision
|   |       |   |   |   |       |-- content       ASCII / hash / parsed structure
|   |       |   |   |   |       |   `-- structure diagram | tree(rootIds, nodes)
|   |       |   |   |   |       `-- sourceContext / jumps?
|   |       |   |   |   |           `-- binding? / contentHash / mappings / evidence
|   |       |   |   |   `-- edges[] / sections / jumps?
|   |       |   |   `-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
|   |       |   |       |-- selection.items[]    ordered membership
|   |       |   |       |   `-- id / displayNodeId / region?
|   |       |   |       |       `-- captured ASCII / revision / rect / selectedIds
|   |       |   |       |-- diagramViews?        per-instance content folding
|   |       |   |       |-- display: DisplayState
|   |       |   |       |   `-- rootIds / nodes   owned floating-pane tree
|   |       |   |       `-- controls             focus / active thread / surfaces
|   |       |   |-- nodes(): CanvasDisplayNode[] -> canvasDisplayNodes(...)
|   |       |   |   |-- shared                   id / version / childIds
|   |       |   |   |                            expansion / collapsible subtrees
|   |       |   |   |-- grid                     diagram | group; geometry in cells
|   |       |   |   |   `-- boxId / content? / contentNodes? / diagram?
|   |       |   |   `-- floating                 geometry in pixels / placement
|   |       |   |       |-- selection            captured region / child display mode
|   |       |   |       |-- projection           title / revision refs / content
|   |       |   |       |   `-- content variants
|   |       |   |       |       |-- call-tree     result / coverage
|   |       |   |       |       |-- compaction    files[]
|   |       |   |       |       |-- source-code   project / file / ranges / scroll
|   |       |   |       |       `-- code-panel    selectionId / panel / scroll
|   |       |   |       |-- conversation          thread / anchor / draft / presentation
|   |       |   |       |-- detail                title / ASCII / sectionId?
|   |       |   |       `-- arrow                 derived from document.edges
|   |       |   |-- applyUpdate(version, operations) / select / updateCanvas
|   |       |   |-- undo(redo)                   delegates to historyService.navigate
|   |       |   `-- persistenceChanges / exportHistory / forkHistory
|   |       |       `-- delegate with context    service interprets the handle
|   |       `-- readable stores                  publish controller references
|   |           |-- document / presentation / selection / controls / geometry
|   |           `-- status                      isDirty / sceneDirty / canUndo / canRedo
|   |-- controllers[documentId]                 references to session controllers
|   |-- setDrafts(...)                          create/replace/dispose sessions
|   `-- copyDocument(...): { documentId }        fork history; reset selection/controls
|
|-- viewState: SourcePaneViewState               owns live scroll and camera state
|   |-- entries[documentId][paneId] / cameras[documentId]
|   `-- captureDisplay / captureCamera           sample into saved/exported view
|
|-- page coordination                           activeId / transfers / pendingTransfer
|   |-- useAgentCanvasBridge -> handleAgentCommand -> session.controller
|   |-- mounted document -> DraggableDiagramCanvas -> MappingPocSelectionCanvas
|   |   `-- session prop                         reads stores; sends controller commands
|   `-- transfer + linked undo/redo              coordinate source/destination histories
|
|-- persistence: WorkspacePersistence            workspace + records + viewState
|   |-- onPersist(ids) -> sync(ids)              per-session history sequence cursors
|   |   `-- metadata / baseline / history delta / captured canvas / viewport / index
|   `-- viewState.subscribe -> syncView(id)      captured canvas + viewport records
|
|-- storage: WorkspaceStorage
|   |-- records: RecordStorage                  cache / pending changes / in-flight batch
|   |-- worker                                  one per opened workspace
|   `-- records.batch -> transport.write -> worker
|       `-- acknowledgement                     advance persisted sequence and revision
|
`-- capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot          explicit full export model
    |-- schemaVersion: 3 / projectId / activeDocumentId / transfers[]
    `-- documents[]: MappingDocumentSnapshot
        |-- representationId                    workspace document key
        |-- savedRepresentationId? / name / revisionId / hidden?
        |-- savedName / savedScene / savedEdges?
        |-- document: MappingGridDocument        from session
        |-- canvas: MappingCanvasState           includes captured display scroll
        |-- viewport?                           captured camera
        `-- history: CanvasHistoryRecord        controller.exportHistory()
            `-- serializeWorkspace(capture()) -> mapping-workspace.json
